scenarios.name: Reflow an expanded panel when an adjacent panel is hidden

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the Create and Modify panels are visible, with Create before Modify
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user opens the panel selector and clears Create
Create is unchecked and its panel is hidden
the Modify panel shifts left while its additional commands remain open
the user selects Create in the panel selector
Create is checked and returns before Modify
the Modify panel and its open additional commands return to their earlier position
